decisive_findings.problem: Tracked *_test.py was candidate-eligible despite default pytest authority.

decisive_findings.verification: Final independent 29-test suite includes actual suffix-named test candidate rejection.

decisive_findings.problem: Repository pytest.py shadowed independent installed pytest and forged PASS although native assertion was False.
decisive_findings.resolution: Import distribution-bound pytest before project sys.path; bind actual pytest import path/hash to environment identity and receipt.
decisive_findings.verification: Independent fixed native probe produced FAIL_NATIVE with real failure; final source 29-test control confirms.

decisive_findings.problem: Candidate induced skip of protected module while unrelated test passed; worker wrongly returned PASS_NATIVE.
decisive_findings.resolution: Any partial skip yields UNKNOWN_PARTIAL_SKIP; skipped-only/no-test remains UNKNOWN_NO_TEST_EXECUTION.
decisive_findings.verification: Independent actual fixed probe and final 29-test contract.

decisive_findings.problem: Authoritative check_native.py selected by immutable python_files could be patched from failing assertion to passing assertion.
decisive_findings.resolution: Parse all five standard original configuration forms as data; protect configured patterns and quoted INI forms.
decisive_findings.verification: Independent direct probe now raises ValueError; final 29-test suite checks all config forms.

decisive_findings.problem: addopts=authority.py explicitly collected an otherwise unprotected authoritative file; candidate replacement turned FAIL into PASS.
decisive_findings.resolution: Any nonempty original addopts is refused as UNKNOWN_INTERFACE before execution. This narrows supported native interfaces.

decisive_findings.problem: testpaths=authority.py explicitly collected a nonstandard authoritative test accepted as production.
decisive_findings.resolution: Immutable explicit testpaths and descendants are candidate-denied; unsafe paths/configurations rejected.
decisive_findings.verification: Final independent 29-test suite includes explicit file and descendant checks.

decisive_findings.problem: Relative repo_path previously let absolute output inside source bypass exclusion.
Nonempty identical-byte replacement could be labeled language extension.
decisive_findings.resolution: Reject exact unchanged replacement before native execution; empty replacement list remains activation.

preserved_nonreplication: Proposed -o python_files=authority.py override alone did not reproduce falsePASS; both baseline and candidate returned UNKNOWN_NO_TEST_EXECUTION. Do not cite it as a demonstrated bypass.
accepted_boundaries: Exact immutable git object reconstruction ignores working-tree untracked/ignored import files and git replace objects; tracked symlinks/submodules unsupported.
Pinned Python executable/version, installed-distribution byte fingerprint and actual pytest distribution import are checked; this is not an exact OS/external-binary or network environment proof.
Nonzero executed tests, zero skips/errors/failures and exit0 are required for native PASS; timeout/collection/missing environment are UNKNOWN.
Candidate source-only patch path and source/output canonicality checks provide bounded scientific integrity; no hostile-process all-effects reference monitor is established.
Native PASS means the declared original suite passed; it does not prove protected improvement, observational novelty, complete grammar exhaustion, O1-dependent discovery or O3 policy acquisition.

positive_findings: New FLASH evidence kind maps only to installed source-bound native_frontier validator.
Machine routed generic execution checks exact repository/commit/profile and same warrant state.
Runtime performs two fresh native verification calls on admission and fresh native execution for consequences; no caller receipt admission parameter.
Control empty candidate is explicitly ACTIVATION; cut/restoration use exact support and new generation; restart is separate process.
Controller preserves UNKNOWN for missing verifier/environment and already-satisfied obligations; O1 and O3 are not fabricated from historical kernels.
root_action_items: Archive pinned control/target native source bytes rather than only upstream commit/hash metadata.
Snapshot available Machine costs/retention at every save, including early UNKNOWN/failure.
Validate freeze source_commit against actual HEAD and unchanged original freeze hash in check_freeze.
expanded_runtime_review.comparative_boundary: Observed native-status tie alone is not a strong developmental acquisition-cost comparison. Search traces and complete costs remain separate; no O1/O2/O3 superiority is established.
expanded_runtime_review.mission_boundary: No current controller path creates O1 or O3, so a green workflow can qualify generic admission plus an honest prospective negative/UNKNOWN only, not the requested recursive-development success.
